articles.title: Aave founder says V3 unaffected after third-party adapter exploit drains $305K
articles.snippet: Aave founder Stani Kulechov said Aave v3 was unaffected after an attacker exploited a third-party adapter to drain about $305,000 from two Safe multisig wallets.

articles.title: Core Lightning warns attackers are targeting unpatched nodes
articles.snippet: Node operators running version 26.06.7 or earlier were told to upgrade immediately.

articles.title: Near Intents Hacked for $3.8M Days After Denying North Korea-Linked Bitget Hacker
articles.snippet: Near Intents froze its cross-chain swaps after a bug let an attacker drain about $3.8 million. The company promised to repay every user.

articles.title: Bitget Hacker Turns to Zcash Privacy Pool After Near Rejects $50M in Swaps
articles.snippet: The attacker behind the $387.5 million Bitget heist has started hiding about $3.8 million in ZEC inside Zcash's Ironwood pool, after Near Intents turned their swaps away.
